claims: The Artemis II mission has four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission crew includes Reid Wiseman as Commander.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA astronaut.
The Artemis II mission crew includes Victor Glover as Pilot.
Victor Glover is a NASA astronaut.
The Artemis II mission crew includes Christina Koch as Mission Specialist.
Christina Koch is a NASA astronaut.
The Artemis II mission crew includes Jeremy Hansen as Mission Specialist.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled to fly around the Moon in 2026.
The Artemis II mission will be the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon in over 50 years.
